name: band
description: Connect this Claude Code session to the Band AI agent collaboration platform: hold an open Band room, receive inbound messages as channel events, and reply/manage rooms and contacts through Band MCP tools.

platform_url.title: Band platform URL
platform_url.description: Band deployment used for browser sign-in and API access.

ws_url.title: Band WebSocket URL
ws_url.description: Band's Phoenix Channels WebSocket base URL.

allowed_senders.title: Additional allowed senders
allowed_senders.description: Comma-separated Band agent/user IDs that may message this session, in addition to the agent's own owner.

enable_contacts.title: Enable contact tools
enable_contacts.description: Let this agent manage Band contacts (approve/reject contact requests). Off by default: approving a contact widens who can reach a session that runs shell commands.

enable_memory.title: Enable memory tools
enable_memory.description: Let this agent store and recall persistent memories across sessions.
